kind: Yoga source correction and Vietnamese localization

before.name: Pigeon Pose
steps: Extend your right leg behind you and place your right ankle on top of your left thigh, with your right knee pointing out to the side.
Sitting up straight, use your hands to gently press down on your right knee while at the same time pulling your left buttock back.
Hold for 5-10 deep breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

after.name: Pigeon Pose
steps: Start on your hands and knees. Bring one knee forward, with your shin across the front of the mat, and extend the other leg straight behind you.
Sit upright, gently press the bent front knee down, and draw the hip on the extended-leg side back.
Hold for 5-10 deep breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

evidence.source_page_status: Live page displayed the original three steps and front and side demonstration views.
evidence.visual_observation: Both views show the defining Pigeon shape: one knee and shin folded across the front, with the other leg extended behind. The written first step instead assigns both actions to the same right leg and places its ankle on the opposite thigh. Step two refers to a bent right knee and the left hip, while step three says to repeat on the other side. The repair uses body-role wording so the setup is clear without inferring left/right orientation from the camera.
evidence.source_media_limitation: The database snapshot has empty direct videoUrl values for these records; the original MuscleWiki detail page itself rendered the two demonstration views used for this review.
